name: sap-anywhere-xero-integration
description: Integrate SAP Anywhere with Xero so as to create and update objects in Xero based on events occurring in SAP Anywhere. To use this integration, it is assumed that the customer already has a paid plan for Xero. Additional information regarding the integration can be found here.

name: openrainbow-admin
description: The OpenRainbow Admin API returns administration data for business applications that require chat, messaging, and voice features. Available in REST architecture with JSON format and API Key as the authentication method. Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise Rainbow is a cloud-based relationship management platform that connects people, things and systems.

name: oracle-service-cloud-knowledge-advanced
description: The Oracle Service Cloud Knowledge Advanced API provides numerous functionalities for accessing and developing knowledge resources. The API facilitates the addition, modification, and interaction with cloud-based knowledge resources. It allows users to search and make recommendations for articles in addition to accessing user information from external apps. This API allows developers to customize Oracle Service Cloud applications and integrate third-party applications. Developers can also use it to integrate Oracle’s suites of applications including Siebel and E-Business Suite. The API sends HTTP-formatted requests and returns JSON-formatted responses.

name: xedi
description: XEDI enables businesses to exchange documents with trading partners using EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) software. XEDI offers automated tools to receive orders from retail customers and send invoices for automatic payments. By using EDI, developers can enable efficient and accurate data transfer between businesses and organizations.

name: fire-webhooks
description: This Fire Webhooks API allows you to be notified of events in real time for fire.com accounts. This includes notifications for payments, withdrawals and more. Fire Financial Services is business and personal digital accounts that are regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland.

name: apptivo-developer
description: The Apptivo Developer API makes it easier for developers to interact with the Apptivo platform to manipulate its functionality. The API aids the creation of new sales leads, modification of marketing targets, management of jobs and candidates, management of company events and news items, and creation of support tickets. Use the RESTful API to make any application to both read and write your Apptivo firm. The API conveys requests and responses in JSON format.

name: tokenly-music
description: This API allows you to register and login users, retrieve album and song listings and retrieves song download information if authorized for the user. Tokenly gives acces to Tokens, a digital representation of exchange for trading cards, songs, movies, games, loyalty points, memberships, and more.

name: hubtel-sell
description: The Hubtel Sell API offers a way for businesses to receive online payments. The API supports mobile payments, credit cards, debit cards, and more. The API employs Base64 HTTP Basic Auth for authentication, and requires each request to include username and password. Hubtel is a mobile technology firm that delivers customer service and payment solutions.

name: thought-industries
description: The Thought Industries API allows programmatic access to tools and services that retrieve information about events, create and change resources and more. This REST API supports query string parameters for GET, PUT and POST requests with data that is returned in JSON. Authentication is utilized via HTTP Bearer Authentication and API Key. The Thought Industries platform is a customized learning environment with dedicated portals to create multi-tenant portals for customers, partners, to build mobile-friendly sites and pages using drag-and-drop widgets and others. Thought Industries powers learning for business and provides a global B2B customer training platform.

name: clearbit-enrichment
description: The Clearbit Enrichment API integrates person lookup features that include name, location, and social handles. It is available in REST architecture with JSON format and SSL standard.

name: delionio
description: The delion API is organized around REST and has predictable, resource-oriented URLs that uses HTTP response codes to indicate API errors. Delion supports cross-origin resource sharing, allowing you to interact securely with the API from a client-side web application. JSON is returned by all API responses, including errors, although the libraries convert responses to appropriate language-specific objects. Delion provides a REST-API for developers and companies to explore and develop new business models based on IOTA distributed ledger technology.

name: clearbit-discovery
description: The Clearbit Discovery API integrates companies search with customized criteria, such as funding, type of technology, and similarity. Developers can access the REST API with Key to send & receive JSON responses under an SSL standard.

name: sisense
description: Sisense provides big data and business analytics services. The Sisense API allows integration of Sisense server functions including user management and widgets manipulation. Use the API to implement a widget of the service, automate processes, or implement a UI over Sisense. Available in REST and JSON formats & accessible with token.

name: grow
description: The Grow API returns business intelligence data, aiming to improve marketing and sales revenue. Grow provides full-funnel visibility to sales professionals. The Grow REST API connector supports basic authentication and JSON path to data fields.

name: eleap
description: eLeaP is an LMS (Learning Management System) designed for both students and company trainees. Users can easily create online courses that can be customized, branded, and even sold. The LMS automatically tracks each student's progress and sends reports to their instructor. eLeaP is entirely web-based and works on all mobile devices. The eLeaP API enables users to integrate the LMS into their systems.

name: coupa-core
description: Coupa offers Business Spend Management software, with solutions for transactions across procurement, payments, and supply chain. The Coupa Core RESTful API enables users to retrieve and manage data from the platform including accounts, budget lines, business entities, currencies, departments, projects, payment terms, suppiers, shipping, users, taxes, transaction resources (approvals, charges, payments, expense reports, etc.), and shared resources (form, commodities, comments, budget period, tagging, etc.).

name: openrainbow-authentication
description: The OpenRainbow Authentication API returns authentication data for business applications that require chat, messaging, and voice features. Available in REST architecture with JSON format and API Key. Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise Rainbow is a cloud-based relationship management platform that connects people, things and systems.

name: worldbox
description: Worldbox provides reports about companies around the world. Information such as company credit reports, company profiles, management reports, and legal status is available. The Worldbox API is used to integrate a company index and information retrieval service. This REST API uses JSON for data exchange, API Keys and API Secret for authentication.

name: odoo
description: The Odoo platform has over 3,000 free open source business apps that companies can use for building web presences, integrating sales & CRM systems, accounting and internal business management, marketing, recruiting employees, for productivity, and much more. The Odoo platform can be integrated with external applications as well. Using the Odoo API, 3rd party applications using specialized software can interact with Odoo apps to transfer their own data over JSON-RPC or XML-RPC protocols using the OpenERP framework. These traits make Odoo a good companion for eCommerce and SaaS providers.

name: processmaker-restful
description: ProcessMaker provides open source workflow software and BPM Software. Workflow simplified. Programmers code less, business analysts do more, and organizations run better. The RESTful API for the ProcessMaker platform that allows developers to have full control over all functions in both the designer and the run-time engine as well as the ability to embed ProcessMaker in any type of system or product.

name: hubtel-ussd
description: The Hubtel USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Service Data) API is a service that allows GSM communications. The USSD API features WAP browsing, prepaid callback service integrations, mobile money services, location-based content services, and menu-based information services. The API employs Base64 HTTP Basic Auth for authentication, and requires each request to include username and password. Hubtel is a mobile technology firm that delivers customer service and payment solutions.

name: xmatters
description: The xMatters API provides methods for accessing devices, device types, device names, groups, group calendars, people, shifts, and sites programmatically. xMatters is a company that offers business communication services. It provides its users with intelligent two-way communications, business continuity, proactive communications, streamlined business operations, and internet of things infrastructure.

name: chain-data
description: Off Chain Data's API empowers your smart contract by giving them a reliable and useful source of information about what is happening in the real world.

name: clearbit-webhooks
description: Clearbit Webhooks allows developers to access other Clearbit APIs, such as Reveal, through webhooks that connects the service for the time of response. Developers can link up endpoints of Clearbit APIs to webhooks through webhook IDs in account settings. Clearbit offers solutions for developers to construct business intelligence APIs.

name: kickfire
description: The Kickfire API provides users business intelligence for a wide range of applications such as content personalization, ad-targeting, form enhancement, applications, CRMs. Developers can utilize the KickFire service by making RESTful calls to its API. KickFire provides sales automation and data mining services to businesses.

name: leicheck
description: LEICheck is a REST based platform that returns queries related to Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) numbers and entities. Developers can verify the validity of a LEI, search for entities, and retrieve updated lists. The API supports JSON for responses. LEICheck features a fixed plan with 5,000 monthly requests.

name: nip24pl
description: The nip24.pl API (NIP, REGON, KRS) offers corporate information of businesses in Poland. This data is provided by the Central Statistical Office database (GUS - REGON). Available information includes company status, invoice formatted data, company details, and contact details. This information is available in XML format. name: stomt
description: stomt is a feedback platform for business oriented applications. It can be used to build extensions, and widgets. The stomt API is REST based and returns data in JSON format. Also, it uses Tokens for authentication. stomt develops software tools that let customers influence companies by using a feedback and validation system.

name: intellizence-layoffdownsizing-data
description: Dataset of Companies that are doing major layoffs/downsizing in USA and Canada. The API enables specific key fields such as number of positions, locations, type of job, role impacted, and layoff reason (pandemic, etc).

The API employs Base64 HTTP Basic Auth for authentication, and requires each request to include username and password. Hubtel is a mobile technology firm that delivers customer service and payment solutions.

name: finnworlds-company-information
description: The Company Information API is a data delivery format that allows you to get instantly general company information data that is subdivided into five main categories:1. company overview of misssion, vission and values2. executive corporate leadership and their roles3. contact information, address and headquarters4. sector and industry of business operations5. total number of employeesFinnworlds Company Information API provides company information data of only publicly traded companies listed on different stock exchanges.

name: tokenly-bvam-provider
description: This API adds and validates a temporary BVAM document and provides a mechanism to define detailed information about a Counterparty asset. Blockchain Validated Asset Metadata (BVAM) is a method which allows Counterparty Token metadata to be stored off-blockchain yet still be verifiable and inalterable. It allows you to buy, sell, trade, or rent tokens for any traditional currency, digital currency, or other tokens. Tokenly gives acces to Tokens, a digital representation of exchange for trading cards, songs, movies, games, loyalty points, memberships, and more.

name: backstitch
description: The Backstitch API intends to allow for developers to build and access backstitch topic pages to leverage Backstitch content curation engine for apps. Use the API to bulk build topics, add sources & filters, and manage user-specific streams of curated content.

name: ayypi
description: Ayypi offers an API for multiple business services. Currently offered are methods for translation, currency conversion, retrieving song lyrics, current city weather temperature, and screenshot capture with more offerings on the way.

name: natural-insight-routing

name: bunchball

The platform includes a flexible rules engine that enables developers to build programs tailored to their specific audiences and use cases. Bunchball Nitro also comes with advanced analytics and prebuilt UI modules.

name: national-university-singapore-integrated-virtual-learning-environment

API features such as JSON protocol and API Key are available on Mashup and they are governed by the University Acceptable Use Policy. Known as a Learning Management System, the VLE offers academic programs, media space, and classroom responses systems.

name: target365

name: gem-consulting-retail-pricing-optimizer

name: hubspot-company-properties

It can also be used to create, update, delete, and get groups of company properties. HubSpot provides a stack of products that include customer relationship management, marketing, and sales services.

name: roll
description: The ROLL API provides a GraphQL platform for mutable queries associated with business projects, sales pipelines, and analytics. The API requires Tokens for authentication. ROLL is business management platform designed to improve business performance by implementing an all-in-one full visibility service that covers financial situation, sales, time reporting, and project tracking summaries.

name: omniata-content

Its features include data source unification, data model customization, analytics, and marketing automation. The Omniata Content API is used to modify marketing content. This API is REST based, supports JSON content, and requires API Keys for authentication.

name: mindtime

The MindTime API offers programmatic access to survey, results, content, and session data. The API is useful to identify and understand individual differences in thinking styles for organizations and their audiences, and to help businesses rethink processes and structures. Contact provider for documentation.

name: kitewheel
description: Kitewheel offers a customer journey platform that enables journey mapping and design, automation, optimization support, and analytics. Kitewheel Graph is the basic building block for customer journey execution. This allows for orchestrated events, and personalized customer experiences across all interaction channels.

This API is to be used with the Contacts API. HubSpot is an inbound marketing software platform that provides companies a way to attract visitors, convert leads, and close customers.

name: clearbit-reveal
description: The Clearbit Reveal API integrates the retrieval of a company IP address information. It aims to be useful for analytics, customize landing pages, and de-anonymize traffic from a website. Developers can send HTTP requests to receive JSON responses in return. The interface is available in REST architecture with SSL standard method.

The consortium has developed the IMS Caliper Analytics™ Sensor API to facilitate the development of online learning applications. The API is deigned to capture and transmit highly contextualized data of learning interactions. This API conveys responses in JSON or JSON-LD format.

name: besttime
description: BestTime API enables users to add data about the best times to visit a business into applications.

These headlines can be ported into existing CRM, newsletters, and information portals.

name: cors-scan

Each XMLelement within the tag will be presented in chronological order according to the date each Route within the date range chosen has occurred.

name: orange-business-apps-france
description: The Orange Business Apps France API provides tools to develop business applications that interact with partners and provide a state of the art customer experience. description: The Hermes API is an access portal to business profiles more than 3.5 million companies registered in the Czech Republic. name: workflowgen-graphql
description: Workflow engine and BPM operations can be operated via the GraphQL API, such as retrieving requests and action data and statuses, launching new requests, updating request data, completing and assigning workflow actions, and managing delegations.

Educators, administrators, and students can benefit from this modular PHP system that aims to personalize learning environments. To integrate in LMS applications, Moodle offers core the APIs such as Access, Data manipulation, and Navigation API, along with over 20 general APIs that include Calendar, Enrollment, and Media API.

name: tradefeeds-company-information

Company profile overview that includes mission, vision and values, executive leadership, contact information, sector and industry in which the business organizations operates are compiled into comprehensive data retrievable from our API database.

The API returns JSON and XML formatted responses. Catalytic is a business cloud platform used by operations, finance, procurement, HR, and legal organizations to automate variable processes.

The API supports customized search and list building by criteria (including location, industry, keywords, and size). Profile details consist of revenues and revenue histories, growth rates, and industry segments. Developers need to request an API Key.

name: printapi-print-url-to-pdf
description: You can convert any public or private Webpage to PDF file and download it locally or send to customers quickly and reliable using our service.

name: clearbit-person
description: Clearbit offers solutions for developers to construct business intelligence APIs. Using the Clearbit Person API, users can lookup employee information by using a contact's email to return available data on the person. This information includes applicable social profiles, Twitter & Facebook handles, avatar URLs, and basic information such as name, location, and biography. All calls and responses with the Clearbit REST API are done in JSON formats over a secure SSL connection. Clearbit also offers other services such as company lookup, OFAC verification, and geolocation. The API is able to take up to 600 calls per minute. name: workadu

Workado is a next generation online management software and business management system that will help you set up your business on the cloud, with the abilty to access services; for a website builder, to promote your services, and an online booking engine.

name: pitchbook

name: kaseya-bms

The Kayesa BMS API enables developers to programmatically access the platform, with methods to manage accounts, contacts, products, projects, tasks, security, hardware assets, service desk tickets, templates, attachments, users, views, and much more.

name: north-data-german-companies
description: North Data is a provider of a database of profiles of German companies. The API sends requests in URI Query String/CRUD format and returns responses in JSON or XML format.

You can open, close, update, suspend an account, log-in and others.

name: formsite
description: FormSite.com is a site that allows users to build online html forms and web surveys. There are over 100 pre-built forms that users can customize. The site also provides the functionality to email, analyze, share, and download survey data. The RESTful API allows users to interact with forms and results. Currently responses are formatted in XML but JSON and CSV may be added based on user demand.

name: vendasta
description: The Vendasta API integrates sales and marketing features into business applications. As a platform, protocols are available in JSON and HTTP, while authentication is required via Key. Vendasta is an intelligent sales platform for vendors who target small and medium sized businesses.

name: dns-fuzzer
description: DNS fuzzing is an automated workflow for discovering potentially malicious domains targeting your organization. This tool works by generating a large list of permutations based on a domain name you provide and then checking if any of those permutations are in use. Additionally, it can generate fuzzy hashes of the web pages to see if they are part of an ongoing phishing attack or brand impersonation, and much more!

name: ontraport
description: The Ontraport API integrates and customizes business data into applications, aiming to automate customer information flow. It is available as REST architecture in XML and JSON formats and accessible with Api Key. Ontraport is a marketing and business platform for entrepreneurs.
